rationale: Pivot to torch_toto2: default HP first-shot already breaks the W4 0/20 wall AND keeps the W2 threshold sweep alive at thr=0.55 (rare for TS-foundation wrappers). avg_ann +9.5% beats every torch_ttm iter and both baselines. Train mode should sweep horizon ∈ {32, 64, 96}, channel_indices (default 7-curated vs [7,8] per-stock dispersion vs [7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14] 8-channel bundle), head_hidden, dropout (0.05–0.30), lr (3e-4–3e-3) while holding pos_weight ≤ 1.5 per timesfm-pos-weight-2-regresses.
